name: Novo Nordisk CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Novo Nordisk A/S is a global healthcare company that discovers, develops, manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products. Its segments are Diabetes and Obesity Care, covering diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and emerging areas, and Rare Disease, covering hormone replacement therapy and rare disorders of the blood and endocrine system. It was founded in 1923 and has its head office in Bagsvaerd, Denmark.
